title: Nearest Neighbours
statement:
There are `n` points on a plane. Pick the `k` points closest to the origin `(0, 0)` by straight-line distance. If several points are at the same distance, it does not matter which are picked, since only the total matters.

Print the sum of the squared distances `x^2 + y^2` of the `k` picked points.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `x` and `y`.

## Output
Print the sum.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 10000`
- `-10^6 <= x, y <= 10^6`
